footer.tagline: We restore dignity, create opportunity, and bring hope alive — through action.

hero.description: Millions of underserved people still lack access to health, education and opportunity. CHADI is changing that — one life, one community at a time.

aboutPreview.title: Creating Sustainable Impact Across Communities
aboutPreview.p1: CHADI International is a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving lives through education, healthcare, innovation, environmental sustainability, humanitarian assistance and youth empowerment.
aboutPreview.p2: We believe lasting change happens when communities become active participants in their own development.
